name: Great Hall of the Biblioplex — "if this land isn't a creature, it becomes" animates the land itself
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (theme: manlands with a quoted ability). The leading 'If this land isn't a creature,' was stripped as a resolution condition, leaving 'it becomes …', which the fired-ability code turned into a creature picker. 'it' after 'if this land/permanent …,' is now the permanent the condition names, so the effect pins to the source. The Hall becomes a 2/4 Wizard creature land with the quoted ability; the Bears are untouched.

call: If this land isn't a creature, it becomes a 2/4 Wizard creature with "Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn." It's still a land.
